info.title: Builders Marketplace API
info.description: Contract for issue #1. Fixture-backed catalogue; checkout calls PayPal Orders v2.

post.description:
Draft a project from an idea: the LLM lists the materials, prices come from the cache, and a
cache miss is priced with a live Channel3 search (capped and memoized in-process). Lines with no
match — or when Channel3 is unavailable — are returned unpriced (null prices) and left out of
the total. The draft is kept in memory (lost on restart) and never listed by GET /projects.

502.description: The drafting model failed or returned nothing usable

503.description: No LLM key is configured on the server

get.description: A draft by id (memory only: an API restart forgets it).

422.description: Invalid body or unknown owned line id

get.description: Public settings for the PayPal JS SDK script tag. Never includes the client secret.

post.description:
Create a PayPal order for the cart the server builds from this request.

The client sends the same input as POST /cart, not prices: the server recomputes the cart
(re-checking any swaps), so a tampered browser cannot set its own total.

Idempotent on the client's ``Idempotency-Key``: a retried or double-clicked submit returns the
order already opened for that key instead of opening a second one, and the same key is sent to
PayPal as PayPal-Request-Id so a lost response cannot leave a duplicate order behind either.
Without a key the request is treated as new (nothing to replay against).

422.description: Invalid body, unknown owned line id, invalid swap, empty cart, or bad Idempotency-Key

502.description: PayPal rejected the request or did not respond; no order was stored

503.description: PayPal credentials are not set on the server

get.description:
Our order record, by PayPal order id (for the confirmation page). Memory only: an API
restart forgets it.

post.description:
Capture an approved PayPal order and return our order record (fulfilment simulated).

``order_id`` is the PayPal order id (the JS SDK passes it to onApprove as ``data.orderID``).
Idempotent: capturing a paid order returns the stored record without calling PayPal again.
The order is marked paid only when PayPal reports the capture COMPLETED.

402.description: INSTRUMENT_DECLINED: restart the PayPal flow so the buyer picks another source

409.description: Buyer has not approved the order, or the capture is not COMPLETED (not marked paid)

502.description: PayPal rejected the capture or did not respond; the order is not marked paid

503.description: PayPal credentials are not set on the server

CartRequest.title: CartRequest
CartRequest.description:
Price a cart without running the agent: for the cart page and PayPal checkout.

swaps omitted -> the deterministic rules pick swaps for the budget.
swaps given   -> exactly these swaps (usually the ones the agent chose on the project page).
The server re-checks every pick (a listed, cheaper alternative of a line not owned) and
prices the cart itself, so a tampered link can only choose among real listed products.
